# A dialog's minimize, maximize and close read as one modern set

## Context

Two readers without context graded the web desktop's frames in #21348 and named the same gap: the minimize, maximize and close glyphs "look mismatched beside the app icons" (#21348's body). #21198's design pass records it as gap 2, "mismatched and retro" (comment 6982004056). The glyphs are `Neo.dialog.Base`'s defaults, so every dialog draws them, not only the desktop's windows.

## The Problem

Measured on `dev` (`c978015997`) in `examples/desktop/basic`, neo-dark:

- The controls are three different drawings from Font Awesome 7 Free's regular set: `far fa-window-minimize` is a bare bar, `far fa-window-maximize` a frame with a filled title bar, `far fa-window-close` a frame with an X. Maximized, `far fa-window-restore` draws two framed windows.
- They render at 24px (`font-size: 1.8em` of the button's 13.3px), beside a 16px title and an app tile whose glyph is 12px.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dialog/Base.mjs` owns three glyph configs, `maximizeCls`, `minimizeCls` and `restoreCls` (lines 113-146). `getWindowActionMap()` dresses maximize as a `Neo.toolbar.ActionButton` toggle (`iconCls` ↔ `pressedIconCls`) and minimize as a plain action.
- `src/dialog/header/Toolbar.mjs:24-25` holds the header's own `actionMap` defaults: `close` (`far fa-window-close`) and `maximize` (`far fa-window-maximize`).
- `resources/css/src/dialog/Base.css:95-98`, `.neo-header-toolbar .neo-button-glyph {font-size: 1.8em}`, sizes every header glyph, a consumer's own actions included.
- `Neo.desktop.AppWindow` sets no glyph of its own; `Neo.desktop.WindowManager` takes minimize from `getWindowActionMap()`.
- Specs that pin the classes: `test/playwright/unit/dialog/WindowControls.spec.mjs` (lines 81-82 and 141; its replacement arm overrides with `fas fa-minus`, lines 148-150) and `test/playwright/e2e/desktop/Basic.spec.mjs:125` (`fa-window-restore`).

Design authority: #21198, comment 6982004056, the owning epic's design pass on the operator's ask to challenge the desktop's design: "before the cut (lock Sun 22 Nov), real apps in the windows, built from engine families (...), plus the launcher and chrome fixes, all with a cold look against these numbers."

## The Fix

1. `src/dialog/Base.mjs`: `minimizeCls: 'fas fa-minus'`, `maximizeCls: 'far fa-square'`, `restoreCls: 'far fa-clone'`, with their JSDoc defaults.
2. `src/dialog/header/Toolbar.mjs`: `close` becomes `fas fa-xmark` and `maximize` `far fa-square`. Its JSDoc example, which shows `fas fa-xmark` as a custom close, takes another glyph.
3. `resources/css/src/dialog/Base.css`: the header glyph size comes down from `1.8em` to the title's scale. The pull request states the value and measures it.
4. Both specs pin the new classes, and the replacement arm overrides with classes that differ from the new defaults.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Minimize, maximize, restore and close are drawn as a line, a square, two offset squares and a cross; none of them is a framed window.
- [ ] Measured in the browser, no glyph is taller than the header title's font size (16px in `examples/desktop/basic`).
- [ ] `WindowControls.spec.mjs` and `desktop/Basic.spec.mjs` pin the new classes and pass; the replacement arm still proves a replacement.
- [ ] The pull request shows a desktop window, normal and maximized, and one plain dialog (`examples/dialog`), before and after, in neo-dark and neo-light.
- [ ] Readers without context grade the window frame before and after on #21348's question; the pull request records the grades and whether the controls are still named as a weak point.

## Out of Scope

- The dock's glyphs (`src/dashboard/dock/**`): they have their own configs and specs, and `fa-window-restore` is the tear-out's anchor there.
- The header icons' colour per theme: #21371 owns the cyberpunk contrast.
- Buttons that open a dialog or a pop-out (`examples/dialog`, `src/code/LivePreview.mjs`).

## Avoided Traps

- **A desktop-only override in `Neo.desktop.AppWindow`:** it fixes one consumer and leaves every other dialog with the mismatched set.
- **Shrinking the current glyphs:** a smaller frame still disagrees with the bare bar beside it.
- **Inline SVG glyphs:** every header control takes `iconCls`, and a consumer overrides it with a class string (`actionMap` and the configs above).
